description: BASE POSE, eyes open: Rimon standing square to the viewer, feet together, tiny arms resting at his sides, calm smile, crown calyx upright, both leaf ears level. Every other frame keeps this body, position, size and outline exactly; only the named part moves
Base pose, eyes half closed (lids down to the middle of each dot eye); nothing else changes
Base pose, eyes fully closed (two short charcoal lines); nothing else changes
Base pose, eyes half open again (same as frame 2); nothing else changes
Base pose, eyes open, mouth widened into a big warm closed smile with cheeks lifted; nothing else changes
Base pose, left eye (viewer's left) closed to a short curved line, right eye open, small smile tilted to that side; nothing else changes
Base pose, mouth opening to a small oval, eyes drooping slightly; nothing else changes
Base pose, mouth wide open in a tall yawn oval, eyes closed, one tiny arm lifted to cover the mouth, leaf ears tipped back; body position unchanged
Base pose, mouth closing to a small sleepy smile, eyes half open, arm coming back down; body position unchanged
Base pose, both tiny arms raised halfway outward, eyes open; body position unchanged
Base pose, both tiny arms stretched straight up, eyes squeezed shut, crown calyx tipped up a touch, body stretched taller by a few pixels but feet in the same place
Base pose, arms coming down to shoulder height, eyes open and bright, content smile; body back to base height
Base pose, mouth open in a wide grin, eyes curved into happy arcs; body position unchanged
Base pose, head tipped back slightly, mouth wide, eyes shut tight, leaf ears bouncing up, tiny arms out; feet in the same place
Base pose, head level again, mouth a big open grin, eyes happy arcs, one tiny arm on the belly; feet in the same place
Base pose, whole head and crown tipped forward a little (chin down), eyes open, small smile; feet in the same place
Base pose, head back to level with eyes open and a pleased smile; identical to the base except the smile
Base pose, right tiny arm (viewer's right) raised to head height, open palm, eyes open, friendly smile; everything else as the base
Base pose, the same raised arm tilted outward by about thirty degrees as the second half of a wave, same smile; everything else as the base
